title: Foundational ADR set for pluggable cognitive memory
decision_scope: Binding architecture decisions required before the M0 go/no-go gate and implementation milestones M1 through M6.

decisions.title: Place the capability-based provider boundary above Native fact-store contracts
decisions.decision_summary: Providers implement versioned capabilities above TraceDecay application ports. TraceDecay Native remains the explicit-fact authority; cognitive providers return advisory recall and receive observations/outcomes without implementing ProjectMemoryFactStore.

decisions.title: Keep TraceDecay authorities canonical and provider memory advisory
decisions.decision_summary: Current code, exact scope identity, sessions, accepted Native facts, curated rules, and final context assembly remain TraceDecay-owned. Provider candidates are labelled, scope-bound, provenance-bearing advisory evidence with no implicit promotion.

decisions.title: Isolate provider contracts, fabric, adapters, context, and conformance in product-owned crates
decisions.decision_summary: Use additive product-owned crates with inward provider contracts, provider-neutral orchestration/context, isolated Native and NCM adapters, and mechanical dependency guards. Only the narrow registry/composition layer constructs concrete adapters.
required_rejections: Put provider logic in the root `tracedecay` crate

decisions.title: Keep provider contracts topology-neutral and defer the first NCM topology decision
decisions.decision_summary: The provider protocol supports in-process and isolated local-process adapters behind one lifecycle contract. Native starts in-process. NCM topology remains deliberately undecided until the licensed surface audit and an ADR-backed selection evaluate crash isolation, latency, cancellation, state ownership, and reuse.

allowed_candidates: another bounded topology proved by the surface audit

required_rejections: Mandate one execution topology for every provider

decisions.title: Use separate provider state plus a bounded durable observation outbox
decisions.decision_summary: TraceDecay owns a durable bounded observation journal and delivery receipts; each provider instance owns only its internal state. Delivery is at-least-once with stable idempotency, typed partial effects, bounded retries/backpressure, replay, and explicit privacy/retention.
required_rejections: provider state in Native fact tables

decisions.title: Compile final coding context in TraceDecay from separately admitted authority lanes
decisions.decision_summary: TraceDecay alone assembles final request-scoped context. Current code, policy, Native facts, session evidence, and provider candidates remain separate lanes with exact scope, provenance, freshness, deterministic normalization, budgets, and typed per-lane degradation.

decisions.title: Make observer mode mechanically non-influential and active mode explicitly gated
decisions.decision_summary: Observer providers receive post-commit observations and may emit inspection/evaluation traces, but no value reachable from observer execution can affect prompts, canonical state, tools, approvals, or externally visible actions. Active recall requires explicit configuration and conformance/evaluation gates.

decisions.title: Converge with upstream through additive product ownership, mapped exceptions, and isolated sync trains
decisions.decision_summary: The immutable product floor advances only through isolated, reviewable sync trains. Product-owned crates and artifacts stay additive; every existing upstream-file edit is budgeted and mapped with semantic invariants, tests, rationale, and a removal/rebase plan. Exceptions require an ADR before the edit.
